title: Work Style
description: O*NET 31.0 Work Styles: personality tendencies exhibited at work (persona layer A). Rated per occupation in work_role; an agent emphasizes up to four. Descriptions are O*NET's (CC BY 4.0, USDOL/ETA).

higher_order.description: Phase 1 higher-order dimension (Putka, Liu & Lewis 2025, Table 1): a Big Five domain, Honesty-Humility (HEXACO), or Compound Dimensions

trait_domain.description: The IPIP domain the higher-order dimension names (Emotional Stability is low Neuroticism); null for Honesty-Humility and Compound Dimensions

lex_matches.description: skos:closeMatch from lex/temperaments.csv words (editorial); migrates generated temperament words
